effect_unit_note: The paper defines C/F/G a priori as highly anthropic populations enclosed by busy roads and intersections and A/B/D/E/H/I as non-anthropic natural populations. Population is the independent unit; fruits are not n.
Same predeclared habitat contrast as fruit set. Population-level immigration percentages are used; 4,956 paternity assignments are lower-level observations and are not used as independent n.

Population-level Ho values use the same nine populations and predefined landscape grouping. The very large standardized magnitude reflects tiny between-population SD within groups and only 3 vs 6 independent populations; retain full variance and do not interpret as a universal magnitude.
Higher FIS is deterioration, hence orientation -1. This is an alternative adult-genetic representation of the same populations and must not be pooled jointly with Ho as an independent G_adult effect.
